# Vendored scrcpy server

`scrcpy-server-v3.3.3` is the unmodified official server binary from the
[Genymobile/scrcpy v3.3.3 release](https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy/releases/tag/v3.3.3).

- License: Apache-2.0
- SHA-256: `7E70323BA7F259649DD4ACCE97AC4FEFBAE8102B2C6D91E2E7BE613FD5354BE0`
- Purpose: pushed temporarily to the selected Android device when a browser
  interactive session starts; it is not executed on the terminal board.
